text:
vivian_cs: Drafting a short 'micro-handoff' for Evergreen trial tomorrow. Goal: one page the customer's engineers can act on for cache, batch, stream + what CS watches for renewal risk. Pls poke holes.

vivian_cs: HEADLINE TL;DR
- Cache early for repeated prompts, batch to save cost under many small ops, stream for live UX. Add small probes and a rollback trigger. Watch p95 latency and cache-hit-rate as early health signals.

vivian_cs: 1) Pre-launch account health checks
- Warm pool: set to projected TPS * 1.15 for first 2 hours. If ramp uncertain, start 1.3x then scale down.
- Verify telemetry wiring: p50/p95/p99 latency, 5xx count, cache-hit-rate, batch-size histogram, tokens/sec. Owner: platform-observability.
- Enable trace sampling 10% first 48h, drop to 1% afterwards.

vivian_cs: 2) Cache playbook (customer-facing)
- When to enable: prefix caching if >20% identical prompt starts; key by user+prompt-hash to avoid cross-user leakage.
- TTL heuristics: for conversational sessions use TTL = min(15m, session_timeout/2); for static system text 12-72h depending on churn.
- UX pattern: stale-while-revalidate for sub-200ms UX; otherwise set TTL shorter.
- Edge prefetch: if onboarding flow has a deterministic next prompt, pre-warm cache on session start.

vivian_cs: cache sample (minimal):
route: /v1/generate
cache_enabled: true
cache_mode: prefix
ttl_seconds: 900
stale_while_revalidate: true
max_entry_bytes: 262144

alexa_eng: add that on Dedicated we recommend per-tenant max_entries=5000 and soft eviction on memory pressure. Also suggest monitoring cache-quality metric: (cache_hit_rate * avg_response_tokens) to catch waste.

vivian_cs: noted.

vivian_cs: 3) Batching guidance (customer-facing)
- When: many concurrent small requests (<120 tokens). Benefit: cost down, throughput up.
- Adaptive window: grow until p50 latency meets target or maxWindow reached. Example target p50=120ms. Start window 8ms, step 8ms, max 80ms.
- Probe pattern: run labeled traffic `probe=true` (2-5min) during business hours so SRE/Eng can observe batch size distribution.

vivian_cs: SDK example (pseudocode):
client.setBatching({ initialMs:8, stepMs:8, maxMs:80, maxBatch:64 });

raj_cs: For customers sensitive to tail latency, call out a hybrid mode: prioritize low-latency routes (no batching) and background-batch the rest.

vivian_cs: good call, will add.

vivian_cs: 4) Streaming quick tips
- Best for chat/live assistant. Flush partial tokens either every 40-70ms or at sentence boundary.
- Detect stall: if no token for 250ms send keepalive; if repeated failures, retry stream once then fallback to single-response endpoint.

tom_sre: ops note: circuit-breaker suggestion: open if 5xx rate > 3% for 60s, cool-down 30s. Rollback plan: if p95 > 2x baseline for 3m -> disable cache (TTL=0) and set batching to conservative window (5ms).

vivian_cs: 5) Feedback & renewal signals (what CS watches)
- Daily for first week: p95 latency, cache-hit-rate, batch-size median, error bursts.
- Flags for early renewal risk: sustained p95 degradation (>20% week-over-week), cache-hit-rate < expected, dev NPS < 7 at day 7.
- Action: if flagged, schedule 30-min triage (CS + SRE + Eng) and propose immediate knobs (increase warm pool, lower batch window, or switch to faster model variant).

alexa_eng: add quick curl to verify cache behavior to hand the SE: 
```
curl -i -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"hi","cache_key":"eg_greet_v1"}'
# repeat -> expect header x-cache: HIT
```

vivian_cs: added. Follow-up owner: raj_cs will post the customer's chosen TTLs and batch policy after kickoff.

notify-bot: Docs repo updated at commit 9f7e2b in /docs/onboarding/micro-handoffs.

tom_sre: one more ops note: recommend keeping trace sampling config editable via feature flag so we can reduce quickly if cost rises.

vivian_cs: great. I'll turn this into a single-sheet PDF and attach to invite. Thanks all!
